docs: Topics content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of topics (blog rubrics), each with a short label, a title as a link and a line. One object is valid in every topics layout (cards in two or three columns, rows).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the topics, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

label.docs: the short label (the count, the kind)

description.docs: one line about the topic; empty: none

href.docs: the address of the topic; none: the title is plain text
